text: No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected on this 311.2-hectare property after 2020. The analysis, using Hansen Global Forest Change and JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 data, monitored the area annually from 2021 to 2025. While the method confidently ruled out losses above the 0.5-hectare threshold, smaller-scale changes (under 0.5 hectares) or narrow linear losses could have occurred without being detected, given the 30-meter pixel resolution. The property retained 91.77% forest cover in 2020, but the evidence does not confirm absolute stability or compliance with specific regulations.
